# Draft:Kingsley Edney

----
= Kingsley Edney =
Kingsley John Edney, born 1978 in Wellington, New Zealand, is an academic specialising in the international relations of China and an editor of the British Journal of Politics and International Relations.
Education
He attended Victoria University of Wellington, graduating with a BA(Hons) in Politics and Anthropology in 2001. He studied Chinese language in Shanghai at Fudan University and Shanghai Jiaotong University before completing an MA (2006) and PhD (2012) at the University of Melbourne. During his PhD he spent six months as an exchange student at Tsinghua University in Beijing.
Career
In 2013, he joined the School of Politics and International Studies at the University of Leeds.
He is the author of The Globalization of Chinese Propaganda: International Power and Domestic Political Cohesion and the co-editor of [https://www.routledge.com/Soft-Power-With-Chinese-Characteristics-Chinas-Campaign-for-Hearts-and-Minds/Zhu-Edney-Rosen/p/book/9781138631670 Soft Power with Chinese Characteristics: China's Campaign for Hearts and Minds].
His views on Chinese politics and international relations have appeared in various media outlets, including NBC News, The Wall Street Journal, The Globe and Mail, Le Monde, South China Morning Post, and the New Zealand Herald.
